related.title: 傑馬索拉熔鹽太陽能電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「吸熱面積與平均通量」與「鹽膜溫度與流速」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；傑馬索拉熔鹽太陽能電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Receiver area and mean flux" and "Film temperature and velocity" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Gemasolar Solar Thermal Power Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦每平方公尺承受上千瓩的管子：吸熱面積、熱效率、管壁應力、鹽膜溫度與疲勞；傑馬索拉熔鹽太陽能電廠則以第一座商用熔鹽塔：熔鹽流量、太陽倍數、把鹽送上塔頂的泵功率與全天候發電為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tubes taking a megawatt per square metre: receiver area, thermal efficiency, wall stress, film temperature and fatigue; Gemasolar Solar Thermal Power Plant centres on the first commercial molten-salt tower: salt flow, solar multiple, pumping salt up the tower and round-the-clock generation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鏡場面積與年發電量」與「鏡場面積與年發電量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「吸熱器輻射熱損」的模型移到傑馬索拉熔鹽太陽能電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儲熱量與熔鹽質量」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Field aperture and annual energy" and "Field aperture and annual energy".
Move the model of "Receiver radiative loss" to Gemasolar Solar Thermal Power Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Thermal storage and molten-salt mass", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「吸熱面積與平均通量」與「鹽膜溫度與流速」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；傑馬索拉熔鹽太陽能電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Receiver area and mean flux" and "Film temperature and velocity" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Gemasolar Solar Thermal Power Plant must be respecified.

related.title: 集光式太陽能定日鏡校準
related.transfer: 可遷移「吸熱面積與平均通量」與「鹽膜溫度與流速」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；集光式太陽能定日鏡校準的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Receiver area and mean flux" and "Film temperature and velocity" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Concentrating Solar Heliostat Calibration must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦每平方公尺承受上千瓩的管子：吸熱面積、熱效率、管壁應力、鹽膜溫度與疲勞；集光式太陽能定日鏡校準則以讓一萬面鏡子都打中同一個目標：太陽圓盤、誤差合成、截取率與校準時間為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tubes taking a megawatt per square metre: receiver area, thermal efficiency, wall stress, film temperature and fatigue; Concentrating Solar Heliostat Calibration centres on making ten thousand mirrors all hit one target: the solar disc, combining errors, intercept and calibration time, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鏡場面積與年發電量」與「鏡場面積與年發電量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「吸熱器輻射熱損」的模型移到集光式太陽能定日鏡校準，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「編碼器的解析度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Field aperture and annual energy" and "Field aperture and annual energy".
Move the model of "Receiver radiative loss" to Concentrating Solar Heliostat Calibration, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Encoder resolution", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「吸熱面積與平均通量」與「鹽膜溫度與流速」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；集光式太陽能定日鏡校準的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Receiver area and mean flux" and "Film temperature and velocity" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Concentrating Solar Heliostat Calibration must be respecified.

history.title: 太陽能熱發電吸熱器設計
history.text: 2008 年于利希試驗塔建成；2011 年德國航太中心接手營運；2020 年第二座試驗塔啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2008: The Jülich experimental tower was built. 2011: The German Aerospace Center took over operation. 2020: A second experimental tower opened. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
